items.exampleEn: I couldn't sleep after watching that thriller.
items.exampleZh: 看完那部驚悚片後我睡不著。

items.exampleEn: She has played the flute since she was seven.
items.exampleZh: 她從七歲就開始吹長笛。

items.exampleEn: The trumpet is the loudest instrument in our band.
items.exampleZh: 小號是我們樂團最大聲的樂器。

items.exampleEn: He became a TV idol at the age of sixteen.
items.exampleZh: 他十六歲就成了電視偶像。

items.exampleEn: The magician pulled a rabbit out of his hat.
items.exampleZh: 魔術師從帽子裡變出一隻兔子。

items.exampleEn: The old wizard in the story could turn stones into gold.
items.exampleZh: 故事裡的老巫師能把石頭變成金子。

items.exampleEn: The guitarist broke a string during the concert.
items.exampleZh: 吉他手在演唱會中弄斷了一根弦。

items.exampleEn: Children sat quietly around the storyteller in the library.
items.exampleZh: 孩子們安靜地圍坐在圖書館裡說故事的人身邊。

items.sentenceEn: The band is looking for a new guitarist.
items.sentenceZh: 樂團在找一位新的吉他手。

items.audioEn: The magician's show is for children, so it starts at four in the afternoon.
items.audioZh: 這場魔術表演是給孩子看的，所以下午四點開始。

items.sentenceEn: The music teacher plays both the flute and the trumpet.
items.sentenceZh: 音樂老師長笛和小號都會吹。

items.sentenceEn: In the book, a young wizard goes to a magic school.
items.sentenceZh: 在那本書裡，一位年輕的巫師去上魔法學校。

items.stemEn: The ____ was so scary that I closed my eyes.
items.stemZh: 那部驚悚片恐怖到我閉上了眼睛。

items.stemEn: My grandfather is a great ____; he knows hundreds of old tales.
items.stemZh: 我爺爺很會講故事，他知道好幾百個老故事。

items.passageEn: Last weekend, our town held a music and story festival. A magician did tricks with cards, and a storyteller dressed as a wizard told tales about magic animals. Later, a young band played on the main stage. The guitarist and the flute player were only fifteen, and a girl played the trumpet. Many teenagers came to see a pop singer who is their idol. Parents bought souvenirs, and in the evening, an outdoor cinema showed a thriller for older visitors.
items.passageZh: 上週末，我們鎮上辦了一場音樂與故事節。一位魔術師用撲克牌變魔術，一位打扮成巫師的說故事人講了魔法動物的故事。後來，一支年輕樂團在主舞台演出。吉他手和吹長笛的團員都只有十五歲，還有一個女生吹小號。很多青少年來看他們的偶像——一位流行歌手。家長們買了紀念品，晚上戶外電影院為年紀較大的觀眾放映了一部驚悚片。

questions.questionZh: 那位說故事的人打扮成什麼？
晚上的戶外電影院放映了什麼？

items.promptZh: 我妹妹每天練習吹長笛。
referenceEn: My sister practices the flute every day.
My younger sister practices playing the flute every day.
rubricZh: flute 表示「長笛」，例如 play the flute、practice the flute 等說法
主詞是第三人稱單數，動詞要加 -s（例如 practices、plays）
時態配合內容（多用現在簡單式）

items.instructionZh: 用 idol 造一個句子，說說你現在或小時候的偶像。
referenceEn: My idol is a famous tennis player.
When I was young, my idol was a singer.
rubricZh: idol 表示「偶像」，例如 my idol is… 等說法
說的是自己的偶像（例如 my）
時態配合內容（例如現在式、過去式等）
